title: "Increasing employment rates"
author: "Andy Baxter"
format: html
---

```{r, setup}
#| echo: false
#| include: false

here::here("increasing_employment_rates.qmd")

library(reticulate)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

data <- readr::read_tsv(here("data/UK_2023_b1.txt"))

euromod <- import("euromod")

mod <- euromod$Model(here("UKMOD-PUBLIC-B2025.07"))
```

# Baseline runs

```{r, baseline-runs}
if (!dir.exists("output/baseline")) dir.create("output/baseline")

walk(2026, \(year) {
  policy_system <- mod$countries['UK']$systems[glue::glue("UK_{year}")]
  policy_system$run(
    data,
    "UK_2023_b1.txt",
    outputpath = here("output/baseline")
  )
}, .progress = TRUE)
```

# Identifying employment statuses

```{r, employed-unemployed-subgroups}

# Employed group, for calculating hours and wages
sample_hours_wages <- data |> 
  filter(les == 3) |> 
  mutate(dag_grp = case_when(
    dag >= 18 & dag < 25 ~ 1,
    dag >= 25 & dag < 31 ~ 2,
    dag >= 31 & dag < 51 ~ 3,
    dag >= 51 & dag < 56 ~ 4,
    dag >= 56 ~ 5
  ),
      ethnicity = case_when(
        dot %in% 1:4 ~ "White",
        dot %in% 5:8 ~ "Mixed",
        dot %in% 9:13 ~ "Asian",
        dot %in% 14:16 ~ "Black",
        dot == 17 ~ "Other",
        .default = "Missing"
      )) |> 
  summarise(
    across(starts_with("lhw"), median),
    yem = mean(yem),
    n = n(),
    .by = c(dag_grp, dgn, deh, dms, dhr, ethnicity, lcr01, lindi)
  ) |> 
  filter(lindi != -1)

  
replacement_workers <- data |> 
  filter(les == 5, dag %in% 18:64, !is.na(dag)) |> 
  mutate(dag_grp = case_when(
    dag >= 18 & dag < 25 ~ 1,
    dag >= 25 & dag < 31 ~ 2,
    dag >= 31 & dag < 51 ~ 3,
    dag >= 51 & dag < 56 ~ 4,
    dag >= 56 ~ 5
  ),
      ethnicity = case_when(
        dot %in% 1:4 ~ "White",
        dot %in% 5:8 ~ "Mixed",
        dot %in% 9:13 ~ "Asian",
        dot %in% 14:16 ~ "Black",
        dot %in% c(17, 97) ~ "Other",
        .default = "Missing"
      )) |> 
  select(-starts_with("lhw"), -yem, -lindi) |> 
  left_join(
    sample_hours_wages,
    by = join_by(dag_grp, dgn, deh, dms, dhr, ethnicity, lcr01)
    ) |> 
  replace_na(list(n = 1)) |> 
  slice_sample(by = idperson, n = 1, weight_by = n) |> 
  replace_na(
    list(lhw = median(sample_hours_wages$lhw),
         lhw01 = median(sample_hours_wages$lhw01),
         lhw00 = median(sample_hours_wages$lhw00),
         yem = median(sample_hours_wages$yem),
         lindi = sample(sample_hours_wages$yem, size = 1, prob = sample_hours_wages$n))
  ) |> 
  select(-n, -ethnicity, -dag_grp)

sample_workers <- 
  slice_sample(replacement_workers, prop = 0.05)

uprated_pop_5pc <- data |> 
  filter(!(idperson %in% sample_workers$idperson)) |> 
  bind_rows(sample_workers) |> 
  arrange(idhh, idperson)

write_tsv(uprated_pop_5pc, "data/updated_pop_5pc.txt")

```

# Run UKMOD for uprated pop

```{r ukmod-uprated-pop-5pc}

data_5pc <- read_tsv(here("data/updated_pop_5pc.txt"))

if (!dir.exists("output/uprated_5pc")) dir.create("output/uprated_5pc")

walk(2026, \(year) {
  policy_system <- mod$countries['UK']$systems[glue::glue("UK_{year}")]
  policy_system$run(
    data_5pc,
    "UK_2023_b1.txt",
    outputpath = here("output/uprated_5pc")
  )
}, .progress = TRUE)

```
